title: Gated Roar Beast
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: An FM growl bass built from a sine core driven by a climbing fm index and stepped harmonicity, gated rhythmically by a synced tremolo. Over 16 cycles the fm index roars up, the ladder filter sweeps full-spectrum and the tremolo rate doubles, turning a tight low riff into a screaming wide-register snarl before resetting.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 g1 c1 bb0 [eb1 g1] f1>*4").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(3, 13)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 0.5 3>/4")
    .penv("<0 7 0 -5>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.05)
    .tremolosync("<2 4 8 4>/8").tremolodepth(sine.slow(11).range(0.3, 0.85))
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(300, 5200)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.14)
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.18).sustain(0.55).release(0.05)
    .shape(0.4).distort("<0.2 0.5>/8")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).fm(2).gain(0.3))
    .room(0.18).gain(0.9)
)
